data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Malchy carries a deep reminder of the divine kingship of God in our lives. It is a call to submit to His rule and reign in our hearts. The name Malchy also serves as a reminder of the spiritual battle that ensues when we yield to our lower nature, symbolized by the act of Malchus' betrayal of Jesus. Ultimately, it is a encouragement to remain loyal and faithful to God, even in the face of adversity.
